system.description:
The Genin stands on top of one of tallest tree’s just outside of the Leaf village. She claps her hands together focusing. The tree begins to shake, as it grows, slightly. She stops as she realized she was already higher than the canopy. She hears the voice of someone below her. “Hey! Tsunanami, you sure you’re not over doing it?” The Girl standing on the tree, falls to the ground, taking the snacks the other girl brought her. “No, I think I’m making progress. Just this morning, this tree was only to my ankle. Now Look at its Tallest tree in this part of the forest. Sooner or later. I’m going to make this the tallest tree in the world!”

—Yuki Hyūga

At Worlds End, Ch. 13 excerpt.

The Leaf’s Patriarchs

The Senju Clan is a clan that hails proudly from the Land of Fire and is one of its founders. So deeply ingrained and influential, that three of the Leaf Villages Hokage have been Senju, bringing about a new era of prosperity for the leaf each time. Using Mokuton (or Wood release), a user is extremely versatile and able to control, restrict and even seal away an opponent’s Chakra. The power of Wood Release, and by extension the Senju are widely known, so much so that they were heralded as the strongest clan during the Warring states era.

Senju Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Str

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Ninshou.

Wood Release Affinity: You begin with either Earth or Water Release Affinity. (Pick one)

Mokuton Release Techniques: The Senju Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Senju Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Senju Features

Built Different

1st Level Clan Feature

The Senju are known for their inhuman stamina and vitality. Increase your Hit Point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your hit point total by 2.

Additionally, this well of vitality coalesces within you as latent self-restoring energies. You have a well of these healing energies called Senju Cells, of which you have 2.

Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated, you can call upon this healing energy and spend 1 Senju Cell. When you do, roll 1d6 + your half your level, minimum 1. You regain hit points equal to the result. You regain spent Senju Cells when you complete a rest.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 4. Also, at the beginning of your turn, you can spend 1 Senju Cell to end any one Physical or Elemental condition you have.

Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 6. Also, if you begin your turn with 0 hit points, you can spend any number of Senju Cells to spend an equal number of Hit Die, regaining hit points equal to the result.

Mokuton Infusion

1st Level Clan Feature

While the blood of the Senju runs through you, the heritage of one burns brightest. You have access to the unique Mokuton Kekkei Genkai and it suffuses itself throughout your already varied forms of combat. This is represented by your Mokuton Infusion Chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this Chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.

You can enter the Mokuton Infusion stance as a bonus action, when you do, select one of its variants. You can swap between these variants by spending a bonus action on subsequent turns.

Will of the Buddha. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:

When you take the attack action while you wield a Combat Scroll you can choose to instead make Verdant Lash attacks. You can replace each attack you would make as part of the Attack action with a Verdant Lash attack.

Verdant Lash. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, lashing out with bramble strikes. On a hit, you deal the listed melee or ranged damage. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, you inflict 1 rank of Drained and push or pull them 10 feet closer or further from you. This increases to 15 feet, 2 ranks of Drained and this attack is treated as casting a D-Rank Hijutsu at 7th level. Increase the damage dealt by +1 damage die at 11th level. Starting at 15th level, increase the ranks of Drained inflicted to 3.

Melee: 1d10 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.

Ranged: 30 feet, 1d10 Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.

Fist of Hevajra. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes Cold, Earth or Chakra which you choose when you roll damage.

Your unarmed attacks can use your Hijutsu Flexibility trait to calculate its attack and damage rolls.

Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 weapon property as your strikes are followed by branching wood strikes. This increases to Reach 2 at 7th level.

Verdant Bloodline

| Mokuton Infusion – Drained / Max Ranks: 5, [Physical], [Mental] / A Drained creature takes 1d8 chakra damage at the start of each of their turns for each rank it has. / A Drained creature increases the chakra damage they take from hostile creatures attacks or jutsu by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level. / A Drained creature can spend an Action to make a DC 15 Constitution ability check to end this condition. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your link to green isn’t an accident. Your chakra doesn’t just build, it grows, sprouts and reveals its beauty and strength. You can control wood and nature like its second nature. Once per turn as part of an attack made with the Attack action while in your Mokuton Infusion stance or when casting a Senju Hijutsu, you can use the New Growth ability.

New Growth. Select a point you can see on the ground within 60 feet of you as you manifest a 10-foot radius patch of almost sentient foliage such as roots, trunks or brambles. Creatures other than you that move through this affected area spends 4 feet for movement for every 1 feet they move as they try to maneuver through this terrain. This special terrain is named New Growth and lasts for 1 minute or until cleared as a result of a damaging effect crossing affected spaces.

Wood Release

7th Level Clan Feature

The Senju clan has a unique talent for manifesting Wood Release due to their close affinity to both Earth and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Wood Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Water release keywords, you can change the damage type to Earth or cold respectively.

Additionally, once per turn, as a Bonus action, by selecting one creature you can see within 30 feet of you that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or has ranks of Drained. You force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw, being pulled 20 feet closer or pushed 20 feet further away from you on a failed save.

Blood of the leaf

11th Level Clan Feature

The Senju clan has a unique talent for communication and negotiating hostile terms. While you are in communication with a non-allied creature, and they make a request of you. If you attempt to intimidate them in response, you gain 2 ranks of Mastery to the check.

Verdant Domain

15th Level Clan Feature

You are one with the wood. You are the commander of the green. All things in nature are part of your domain. Hostile creatures of your choice that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or are standing in an area under the effects of the New Growth special terrain has their chakra network impeded. When a hostile creature with an impeded chakra network casts a Jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) of a rank higher than the listed rank based on their classification, they gain ranks of Drained for every rank above the listed rank that they cast the triggering jutsu at.

Standard: D-Rank

Elite: C-Rank

Solo: B-Rank
